distribution_paid_declared.note: No distinct declared-GBP-for-FY2025 line exists in the audited Distribution Statement. The statement discloses only (a) cash-paid tranches (P) and (b) DPU 3.19p before / 3.03p after Retention. FY2025 declared distributions span periods only partly paid in-year (2H FY2025 declared Feb 2026, paid 2026, not shown). Nulled per AS-DISCLOSED rule; do not derive.

rollforward.notes: A + B - P = 8,936,000 + 19,303,000 - 17,933,000 = 10,306,000; E = 9,341,000. Simplified identity exceeds E by exactly 965,000, which equals the separately disclosed 'Less: Amount retained for general corporate and working capital (Retention)' line of (965). The FULL audited identity A + B - Retention - P = E holds to the penny: 8,936 + 19,303 - 965 - 17,933 = 9,341. Within the statement's native GBP'000 tolerance (~1000) the residual (965) is under threshold AND is itself a disclosed line, so no line was mis-read. All four A/B/P/E figures are read verbatim from the audited Amount Available for Distribution statement (Note 23, PAGE 161-162). B is the for-year subtotal 19,303, NOT the cumulative 27,274 line.
